TWR: the producer's arithmetic label under METHOD_VERSION 2, whose dim_return_method row names the custodian's equity as V; carries no 'rebuilt from positions' and no 'net of fees'
HOLDINGS_INCOME_FALLBACK: the withdrawn guard substitution (PRD ruling 17, 'never emitted'); FWD-3 is not a fallback and is not holdings-price-plus-income
NOT_MEASURABLE: says there is no number; true only on a blank day, where it is used

columns_null.income_received: FWD-3 does not separate income (inside the value through the cash leg); no _reason column exists
columns_null.fee_amount: FWD-3 is after fees (a drag inside the return); reason FEE_RAIL_UNUSED is the producer's only admitted reason
columns_null.method_version: NULL on purpose: the producer's version 2 names the custodian equity as V
columns_null.return_basis: NULL on a measured day: no admitted value states the positions-rebuilt, net-of-fees method (BLOCKING gap)
